text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, April 28 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel waiting, 3 due by 16/5. No delays.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 12 due by 14/5. No delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 2 waiting, 14 due by 15/5. No delays.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna closed for loading coal from 2300 hrs 4/5 to 2300 hrs 5/5 due to Labour Day public holiday. Two vessels loading, 2 waiting. 23 due by 21/5. No delays.
Barney Point - Loading on Labour Day if required. Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 4/6, no delays.
Brisbane - Six vessels due by 28/5. No delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 1 Vessel loading, 4 waiting, 21 due by 13/5. 3 Days delay in port.
Port Kembla - Conveyor repaired and terminal resumed loading operations at 0900 hrs 28/4. One vessel loading, 1 waiting, 20 due by 1/7. 1 day delay.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Industrial action scheduled for 29/4 was expected to result in rolling stoppages throughout Western Australian ports. With no MUA labour at the iron ore ports, no delays to berthing/loading was expected.

Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to current shortage of lump/fines and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some delays to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. Berth A - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 6 due by 8/5. Berth B - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 5 due by 7/5, 4 others due with no eta.
Goldsworthy - 3 Vessels due by 2/5.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored.
E.I. Island - 4 Vessels anchored.
Dampier lineup - 19 Vessels due by 10/5. A four-day maintenance shudown at E.I. Island from 27/4 following sailing of one vessel.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 anchored, 6 due by 10/5.
April 30 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Brisbane - One vessel loading, 1 due 2/5.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading, 4 due by 7/5.
Sydney - No further grain loading expected at this port.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 1 in port, 12 due. Berthing programme based on grade of cargo receivals by rail.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading wheat, 1 wheat in port, 5 due by 16/5.
Portland - Eight vessels due.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Lincoln - One vessel due 5/5.
Wallaroo - One barley vessel due 4/5.
Port Giles - One vessel due 8/5.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Two vessels loading wheat, 2 in port, 5 due by 20/5.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 4 wheat vessels in port, 9 vessels due by 23/5.
Albany - One wheat vessel due 5/5.
